title: Configuring Safari to Use a PAC File

blocks.text: To redirect your web traffic to the Zscaler cloud, you can configure your browser to use a PAC file. A PAC file is a text file that directs a browser to forward traffic to a proxy server before going to the destination server. The Zscaler service hosts a default PAC file that uses geolocation technology to forward traffic to the nearest Public Service Edge for Internet & SaaS (ZIA). To learn more, see Using Default PAC Files to Forward Traffic to Internet & SaaS.
The browser version used in this example is Safari 11.0.1 (13604.3.5).
To configure Safari to use Zscaler’s PAC file URL:

blocks.item: From the navigating menu, go to Infrastructure > Internet & SaaS > Hosted PAC Files from your Zscaler Admin Console and copy the default hosted PAC file URL to your clipboard.
Open Safari, open the Safari menu, then click Preferences...
In the Preferences window, click Advanced.
On the Advanced tab, go to Proxies and click Change Settings...
In the Network window, select Automatic Proxy Configuration and paste the PAC file URL that you copied from the Zscaler Admin Console.
Click OK to save the configuration.

blocks.text: For more information about getting started on the Zscaler service, see Getting Started.
